Context: EP02 has 19 shots that drifted from approved 2D cartoon style into photorealistic 3D; the plan is to extract skeletons/poses from those clips (DWPose/OpenPose/MediaPipe) and use them as ControlNet conditioning to regenerate the shots in flat 2D cartoon style (Shadow Wizard Money Gang aesthetic), preserving the original motion. Free/accessible tools only, no paid spending. Hardware is a small Linux VM (7GB RAM, likely no GPU) — document what can run locally vs what needs cloud/GPU. Heartbeat the checkpoint ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/pose-guided-setup.json (updated_at ISO-8601) after each completed step, and commit nothing to git unless inside video-fix-tools. Final deliverable: a comprehensive report to the parent agent with findings, installed tooling paths, test results, and the documented pipeline.
